result:
The `store` warning is gone: `PostController.store` now uses `Post.create` with the named fields and `set: { authorId }`, so request data never reaches a `force*` call. Typecheck still passes.

`guren audit` still reports two dependency advisories (high `source-map-js`, low `katex`). They come from `node_modules`, not this change, so I left them alone; upgrading them or recording an ignore in `config/audit.ts` is your call. The `update` action still spreads the request body into `Post.update`, which means a client could reassign `authorId` through the edit form. That is pre-existing and outside this fix, but worth a follow-up.
